name: kidsmeal
description: kidsmeal's Claude Code plugins: Gantry and ClauDHD. Add this marketplace once and install either of them.

plugins.name: gantry
plugins.description: Gantry: a gated design -> plan -> build -> review pipeline with PreToolUse enforcement hooks (a file-list guard and a commit guard) and two living audit docs. Reads each project's own conventions; works in any stack.

plugins.name: claudhd
plugins.description: ClauDHD: a NOW cursor that follows your branch, an idea inbox, a quick-fixes lane, a shipped log, and branch-aware session breadcrumbs. Also published standalone in the claudhd marketplace.
